scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
other_conditions: Must hold a regular position in academia, research institution, or industry, or a long‑term nationally recognised fellowship of at least four years.
Must have a minimum qualification of a Master's in Science or a four‑year Bachelor’s in Engineering.
PhD students and post‑docs affiliated with research institutions or industry are also eligible.
Applicants must form a pair consisting of one Indian and one German early‑career researcher and submit a joint proposal.
The pair’s visits must be completed within 12 months of award initiation, with less than six months gap between the two visits.
A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the head of the applicant’s institution must be submitted with the application.
Applicants must provide a detailed activity plan outlining objectives, work plan and expected outcomes.
Travel dates must be communicated to IGSTC at least 45 days before the planned visit.
Each awardee must submit a UC/SE and a fellowship visit report at the end of their visit, and a consolidated report within four weeks of completion.
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of €2300 per fellow and round‑trip airfare (≈₹1 lakh for the Indian fellow, €1500 for the German fellow) covering visa and travel/medical insurance.
documents_required: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Head of the Institution
